from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper and its citation relationships within the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly references")
    citations_from_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that explicitly cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
